reading.body:
CyrusOne's San Antonio SAT2-SAT4 campus publishes 36 MW of IT capacity, ranking fourth among the 19 Texas facilities that disclose load, but its certifications target regulated enterprise workloads rather than AI-scale compute.

The campus spans 295,785 square feet of technical space across three facilities, with certifications for PCI DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, FISMA, SSAE 16 Type II, and TIA-942. That compliance profile suits finance, healthcare, and federal computing, not the high-density training or inference clusters that drive current AI demand.

Texas publishes capacity figures for only 19 of 133 mapped facilities, so the campus's fourth-place rank and 7.6% share of the state's 475 MW disclosed load reflect reporting scarcity, not strategic weight. No grid or power availability data is published for this site, leaving the binding constraint on AI scaling unmeasured here.
